name: deja-vu
description: Structured prior-art hunt that runs before anything custom gets built.

interface.shortDescription: Prior-art hunt before you build custom
interface.longDescription: Runs a structured prior-art hunt before anything custom gets built — sweeps parallel source lanes, snowballs and probes the strongest hits, and returns a verdict (NOT-A-PROBLEM, DIFFERENT-PROBLEM, DEPEND, FORK, VENDOR, BUILD) with receipts. A BUILD verdict always requires human sign-off.
defaultPrompt: Has anyone already solved this problem?
Check for prior art before I build this
Should I roll my own or use a library?
